notes.title: The Yuletide Month
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001710/91e8bf323beec3e4b11b31cb7ba2f07cd858d2aa.png[/img]

During the month of Yuletide there are some fun holiday theme specials available for players.
[list]
[*] Shapeshifters gaining their tier 1 form have a chance of gaining a special holiday themed form! Freeze your foes as a yuki-onna, abduct as a krampilk, and many more!
[*] Conjurers gaining their familiar this month have a chance of gaining a special holiday familiar. They're pretty cute.
[*] The Inn of the Eternal Star is themed to match the holidays.
[/list]

We also have some new content in the works, so keep an eye out!

Thanks for joining us in the fields and we hope you have a magnificent holiday with family or friends or us!

notes.title: October Spookyfest
notes.content:
October in Carrion Fields is **SPOOKY**!

What does that mean for you?
[list]
[*] Shapeshifters can gain a special tier 1 Halloween themed form during this month, from hellhounds to horrifying tatarimokke and more.
[*] Conjurers can gain Halloween themed familiars when getting their familiar spell.
[*] Bards can learn the haunting rhapsody, a horrific song that gives your enemies spooky nightmares.
[*] To orcs it is known as Orctober, a chance to join a large horde of orc players!
[/list]

Given MANY people play mages during this month, it can also be a special time to play a Battlerager - the cabal focused on the destruction of magic and the death of mages.

No matter what you decide to be, we hope you enjoy the spooky season with us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001710/eff7eeb3bd4539869ecc3507dc405363426f6a3b.gif[/img]
